articles.summary: Frontend and data layers have evolved with branch-based previews and isolated environments. Why is the backend service layer stuck with shared staging?
articles.title: Merging To Test Is Killing Your Microservices Velocity

articles.summary: Bitso eliminated staging bottlenecks for 250+ engineers by using Signadot and Neon to create isolated, high-fidelity sandboxes for every PR. This RISE architecture ensures financial-grade stability by promoting the exact artifacts validated in isolation directly to production.
articles.title: How Bitso Is Scaling Branch-Based Development with Signadot and Neon
